title: Negros police to mobilize over 3,000 personnel for ‘Undas’

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Police Regional Office Negros Island Region (PRO NIR) will mobilize some 3,119 personnel from the Philippine National Police (PNP), partner agencies, and force multipliers from Oct. 30 to Nov. 3, to strengthen security, intensify crime prevention, and safeguard the public during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day. Of the 3,119 forces to be deployed, 1,773 are PNP personnel, 340 are from other units, and 1,006 are force multipliers, the PRO NIR said Wednesday, Oct. 21.
